data.title: Crypto Laundering Service Fee Pattern — Percentage-Based Deduction on Transfers
data.description: Detects cryptocurrency transfer patterns consistent with laundering service fee structures. Illicit crypto exchange services charge 2.8%-8.5% base fees plus a 4% "dirty funds" surcharge, resulting in outbound amounts that are consistently 93-97% of inbound amounts. When a wallet receives cryptocurrency and forwards approximately 93-97% to another address within 24 hours — retaining 3-7% as a service fee — this is a strong indicator of a crypto mixing or cashout service. The retained percentage serves as the service operator's commission. Sourced from Cybercrime Diaries undercover exchange contact research (June 2025).

detection.condition: selection | group by to_address | where outbound_amount / inbound_amount between 0.93 and 0.97 and outbound_count >= 1 and inbound_count >= 1
detection.note: The 93-97% forwarding ratio reflects documented fee structures: ~3.5% base + 4% dirty surcharge = 7.5% (93% forwarded) on the high end; ~2.8% base + 0% surcharge = 2.8% (97% forwarded) on the low end for "clean" funds. The pattern is strongest when: (a) inbound and outbound occur within 24h, (b) the receiving wallet has < 30 days of history, (c) the wallet performs this pattern across multiple distinct source wallets, and (d) the retained percentage is consistent across transactions (service fee, not random). Cross-reference with DL-0197 ephemeral wallet detection.

queries.sql:
WITH wallet_flows AS (
  SELECT
    wallet_address,
    SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'inbound' THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS total_inbound,
    SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'outbound' THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS total_outbound,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN direction = 'inbound' THEN 1 END) AS inbound_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN direction = 'outbound' THEN 1 END) AS outbound_count,
    MIN(first_seen) AS wallet_age_start
  FROM blockchain_transactions
  WHERE token_symbol IN ('USDT', 'USDC', 'BTC')
    AND amount_usd >= 5000
    AND block_timestamp >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY wallet_address
)
SELECT
  wallet_address,
  total_inbound,
  total_outbound,
  ROUND(total_outbound / NULLIF(total_inbound, 0), 4) AS forwarding_ratio,
  ROUND((1 - total_outbound / NULLIF(total_inbound, 0)) * 100, 2) AS retained_pct,
  inbound_count,
  outbound_count,
  wallet_age_start
FROM wallet_flows
WHERE total_inbound > 0
  AND total_outbound > 0
  AND (total_outbound / total_inbound) BETWEEN 0.93 AND 0.97
  AND inbound_count >= 1
  AND outbound_count >= 1
ORDER BY total_inbound DESC

references: Cybercrime Diaries undercover exchange contact research (June 2025)
FATF Guidance on Virtual Assets and Virtual Asset Service Providers
Chainalysis Crypto Crime Report 2025 — mixer/tumbler fee structures
falsepositives: Payment processors forwarding funds minus legitimate transaction fees
DEX aggregators routing trades with slippage/fees
Legitimate escrow services releasing funds minus commission
